# REALTIME_EVENT_CATALOG.md
### Constitution 9 §247 event catalog + §248 channel documentation — GENERATED by `npm run docs:realtime-catalog`; do not edit by hand.

Registry: `packages/realtime-contracts/src/realtime-core.ts` (117 events, all versioned). The client package re-exports it — one registry (Constitution 13 §77); `check:realtime-contract` fails on any copy.

**Payload:** every frame is `{ event, v, screens, payload?, seq, stream }`; `payload` is the sealed envelope `{ eventId, eventType, tenantId, branchId, resourceType, resourceId, updatedAt, version, data }` with forbidden keys stripped and a 32 KB cap. Technician and Customer streams receive event-only frames (no `payload`).

## Channels (§248)

Internal room names are server-derived and never seen by a client (§13/§110); the `stream` slot (`r0`, `r1`) is the only room identifier on the wire.

| Channel | Type | Actors allowed | Permission | Scope | Internal room | Typical events | Snapshot API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branch.queue` | BRANCH | Tenant users (OWNER, MANAGER, FRONT_DESK, RECEPTION) | pos.login | BRANCH (home branch from session) | `tenantBranch(tenantId, branchId)` | `queue_updated`, `customer_checked_in`, `ticket_assigned` | GET /pos/queue |
| `branch.booking` | BRANCH | Tenant users | pos.login | BRANCH | `tenantBranch` | `appointment_created`, `appointment_updated`, `appointment_cancelled` | GET /pos/booking (board range) |
| `branch.serving` | BRANCH | Tenant users; Ticket holder (Customer App) for ticket-scoped events | pos.login · ticket holder | BRANCH / TICKET | `tenantBranch · ticket(ticketId)` | `service_started`, `service_paused`, `service_resumed`, `service_done`, `ticket_ready_checkout`, `ticket_service_line_added`, `ticket_service_line_updated`, `ticket_service_line_removed`, `ticket_line_technician_assigned` | GET /pos/serving |
| `branch.checkout` | BRANCH | Tenant users | pos.login | BRANCH | `tenantBranch` | `checkout_total_recalculated`, `ticket_total_recalculated`, `payment_processing_started`, `payment_approved`, `payment_failed`, `ticket_paid`, `receipt_sent`, `checkout_payment_claimed`, `checkout_payment_claim_released`, `payment_verifying`, `payment_recovered`, `mobile_pay_device_updated`, `checkout_sent_to_mobile` | GET /pos/checkout/:ticketId |
| `technician.me` | USER | TECHNICIAN (self) | technician session | SELF + home branch | `technician(technicianId) · tenantBranch` | `ticket_assigned`, `technician_help_requested`, `technician_help_accepted`, `technician_help_declined`, `follow_up_task_updated`, `daily_follow_up_tasks_created`, `technician_earnings_updated`, `technician_profile_updated`, `tech_salon_membership_approved`, `tech_salon_membership_rejected` | GET /tech/today |
| `owner.dashboard` | TENANT | OWNER | owner session | TENANT (+ home branch) | `ownerTenant(tenantId) · tenantBranch` | `reports_updated`, `owner_alert_created`, `owner_alert_updated`, `owner_payroll_updated`, `settings_updated`, `tenant_status_updated`, `expense_updated` | GET /owner/dashboard · GET /owner/alerts |
| `customer.me` | CUSTOMER | CUSTOMER (self) | customer session | SELF + checked-in branch | `customer(customerId) · tenantBranch` | `customer_follow_up_received`, `customer_profile_updated` | GET /customer/me |
| `platform.live-ops` (server-only) | PLATFORM | SUPER_ADMIN | SuperAdminGuard | PLATFORM (aggregates) | `platform()` | `platform_ops_snapshot` | GET /super-admin/system-status/realtime |

Snapshot APIs listed are the existing screen endpoints the client refetches on `screens`; realtime never introduces a second read path (§180).
